findings.text: The added index key _host_name(server.host) is unreachable through either new test: the declared host there is the already-short 98dci4-gpu-0003, for which _short_host and _host_name return the same string, so deleting line 80 leaves both new tests green and the fully-qualified-declaration case unpinned.

_host_name re-implements the domain cut already owned by scheduler_node_name at imas_ambix/agent/node_probe.py:648; node_probe imports only the standard library, so composing it would not create a cycle, and the repository now holds two owners of 'cut a node name at the first dot'.

assert server['host'] == '98dci4-gpu-0003' compares the published document against the literal the test itself passed to SiteServerConfig, so it moves with its own input; the independent guards are the two assertions around it, and this one only reddens if the document starts taking the entry's host from the registration.

Grouping now places a short-spelled and a fully-qualified-spelled registration of one port under the same server entry, but dedup at registry.py:569 still keys on endpoint.engine_id, which keeps the raw spelling, so the one server entry can show the same port twice as two engines and the docstring's 'a restarted job on the engine constant replaces its predecessor' does not hold across a spelling change.
